children: TriLinc Global Impact Fund will use recent liquidation proceeds to satisfy approximately $2.5 million of pending unit repurchase requests related to unitholder death or disability.
Board waived DRP proceeds limitation for Q3 2026 and approved using available liquidity to fund eligible death/disability repurchases.
Settlements from investments including Cevher and Dock Brasil provided cash enabling the repurchases.
Pending repurchase requests total about $2.5 million based on June 30, 2026 NAV; proceeds payable around Sept 30, 2026 or the week after.
Company does not intend to resume regular repurchases or cash distributions; future actions depend on portfolio realizations and Board discretion.
